quality.q3_order: Per task none/low on first seed; reversed on second.
quality.q2_order: Mode blocks none/low on first seed; reversed on second.
quality.excluded: Incomplete mixed-mode Q2 pilot excluded entirely.

latency.order: Fixed-mode blocks, reversed between seeds; Q2 reverses Q3 order.
latency.paired_selection: Both modes pass substantive task/action rubric; style-only failures allowed.

speed.supplemental: One unpaired Q3 Low decode at 65536; Q3 128000 math is one sample per arm.
speed.resume: Early Q3 speed run interrupted after cold measurements and some decode. Final stage retains these observations and appends warm 16K and Q2 measurements.

grading.side_effects: All unrequested attempts fail, including unsupported offered broadcast/timer/fan calls.
grading.style: Emoji and Markdown are tracked separately from substantive correctness.

scope: Direct native Strata model test with mocked HA tools, not the Assist/Hermes/audio route.
